newsitem.title: FINLAND: Nokia up but Helsinki ends flat,Enso boosts volume.
newsitem.headline: Nokia up but Helsinki ends flat,Enso boosts volume.

text.p: * Shares end mixed in lively trade with volume boosted by big in-house deal in Enso. Many domestic investors on holiday, brokers say. Outlook quiet ahead of long midsummer weekend.
Nokia closes higher, Neste rises on IVO-merger speculation.
Finnish shares ended mixed in quiet trade on Wednesday with the main indices a touch higher thanks to Nokia's rise and volume boosted by a big in-house deal in Enso, brokers said.
Many domestic investors were already sidelined ahead of the long midsummer weekend, they said.
The market lacked a clear direction with some investors fearing the recent long rally had finally run its course.
Thursday would be very quiet and the post-midsummer trend was expected to be determined mainly by Wall Street's performance and how Nokia's ADR fared in New York, brokers said.
